Quick internal note — forwarding my comments on the draft MAP: 

- Performance targets: aim for p50 <= 120ms and p95 <= 480ms for the 1k token clinical prompts under the dedicated pilot config. We'll include continuous batching knobs to hit throughput without breaking latency under 95th percentile.
- Quality tests: define a concordance metric vs. your clinician-labeled set; require >= 88% concordance for pass, with a qualitative review sample of discordant items capped at 50 examples.
- Safety/guardrails: add automated rejection for PHI leakage patterns plus a manual triage step for high-ambiguity outputs.
- Test infra: we'll provide the evaluation harness and a reproducible test runner; Meditech should provide a labeled 500-sample holdout (anonymized).

I'll draft the explicit test scripts in acceptance_checks.xlsx and wire up automation to produce the pass/fail report.

Beth / team — attaching the finalized MAP and acceptance checklist (Meditech_MAP_Final_20271102.pdf). This consolidates the items we discussed and adds explicit pass/fail criteria and the signoff workflow. Highlights: 

- Acceptance tests (automated + manual):
  • Functionality: pass rate >= 97% for templated extraction tasks on the 500-sample holdout.
  • Accuracy/concordance: >= 88% concordance on clinician-labeled set (see concordance_test suite).
  • Latency: p50 <= 120ms, p95 <= 480ms for 1k-token prompts under the dedicated pilot baseline.
  • Throughput: sustained 120 reqs/min with 95% of requests within latency SLO during burst windows.
  • Safety: PHI leakage detection — zero high-severity leaks in a 24-hour rolling window; automated rejection for detected PHI tokens.
  • Rollback trigger: any safety regression > 3% or accuracy drop > 5% on two consecutive daily runs -> automatic rollback to last good variant and immediate incident postmortem.

- Evidence we will provide: SOC2 Type II report (or signed attestation if pre-release), exported audit logs for the evaluation window, per-route token consumption report, and a reproducible evaluation report hosted in a read-only link.

- Signoff flow: (1) Meditech technical approval (HIT team) after automated test pass; (2) Procurement approval on cost envelope; (3) Executive signoff on PO/MSA.

- Timeline (finalized):
  • MAP signature target: 2027-11-06 (DocuSign link below)
  • Onboarding + smoke demo: 2027-11-08
  • Evaluation window: 2027-11-08 — 2027-11-22 (14 days)
  • Decision meeting with stakeholders: week of 2027-11-29

Links & next steps:
- DocuSign (MAP signature): https://app.docusign.com/rw/meditech/map-signature
- HubSpot deal: https://hub.redwood.ai/deals/RW-8471
